text:
Alex R.: taking over primary for the next 8h — pinging folks to confirm perms and coverage. primary=me, secondary=Dan K. I'll watch APAC handoff at 03:30z.
Maria L.: ack — couple quick checks: do you have the `redwood-oncall` AWS role in prod? and grafana access to the Alerts dashboard?
Alex R.: yes for AWS role, but re: Grafana i only have Viewer in org/redwood-prod; can someone confirm that still lets me mute alerts?
Dan K.: Viewer can't mute. you need Team:Oncall or Editor. i can promote you temporarily if SRE approves.
Jen S.: can confirm SRE ok. Alex, i'll add you to Team:Oncall for the shift window (manual change).
incident-bot: New page: PROD-LLM-503 - Latency spike - 1 new incident. PagerDuty: https://pd.redwood.ai/incidents/INC123456 — routed to primary.
Alex R.: saw the page. checking traces now. Maria if PD has escalation rules set? last time it jumped to infra-sre instead of oncall-primary.
Maria L.: PD escalation policy is `prod_oncall_escalation` — it should go to primary then secondary after 5m then infra after 15m. i verified routing last week.
Chris P.: small heads up — Grafana alerting sometimes duplicates for replica clusters; mutes need to be applied on both dashboards (Alerts > LLM Serving and Alerts > Edge Proxy).
Alex R.: noted. Jen — can you add the grafana dashboard links in the handoff checklist? faster if i can click.
Jen S.: done: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/alerts/llm-serving and https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/alerts/edge-proxy. added to the runbook entry too.
Dan K.: AWS assume-role snippet if anyone needs it: ```aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-oncall --role-session-name oncall-session``` Use the session creds and export them locally.
Alex R.: thanks. i can assume but will test now.
Alex R.: (after testing) OK i can assume and my `aws sts get-caller-identity` shows the oncall role.
Maria L.: confirm Grafana mute perms?
Jen S.: granted Alex Team:Oncall Editor rights for duration 2059876543-2059889943 (8h). add to audit log. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC123456 acknowledged by Alex R.
Alex R.: quick customer impact note: atm 12% p95 latency increase for streaming calls; errors low, no drop in requests. marking impact: degraded UX but not data loss. filing initial incident summary in #incidents after shift if it persists.
Chris P.: if latency persists >30m escalate to infra-sre for tracing.
Dan K.: i'll be reachable on DM and will watch secondary queue. gap: APAC overlap 00:00–03:30z — i'm oncall but latency spike at that time may need someone local; tagging @Maria L. you good to cover early APAC if it's noisy?
Maria L.: i can cover 00:00–02:00z if needed. beyond that, ops-sre rotation should catch.
Alex R.: perfect. last checklist items before i close handoff: 1) Verified PD routing, 2) AWS role assume confirmed, 3) Grafana muting rights granted, 4) runbook links present, 5) secondary contact set to Dan K., 6) APAC coverage noted.
Jen S.: all added to the handoff doc: https://wiki.redwood.ai/oncall/handoffs/2059876543. please add any follow-ups.
Alex R.: will update if the incident changes. thanks team — taking primary now. :thumbsup:
